title: Poseidon: sea, earthquakes, and horses
reference: MythosAI project notes, summarized from scripts/populate_data.py: Poseidon god record
text: Poseidon is the god of the sea, earthquakes, and horses. His Roman name is Neptune, and his symbol is the trident.

title: Athena: wisdom and battle strategy
reference: MythosAI project notes, summarized from scripts/populate_data.py: Athena god record
text: Athena is the goddess of wisdom and strategic warfare. Her domains include wisdom, battle strategy, and crafts. Her Roman name is Minerva, and her symbol is the owl.

title: Hades: ruler of the underworld
reference: MythosAI project notes, summarized from scripts/populate_data.py: Hades god and Underworld location records
text: Hades is the god of the underworld and the dead. The Underworld is the realm of the dead ruled by Hades. His domains include death and riches, his Roman name is Pluto, and his symbol is the Helm of Darkness.

title: Medusa and her petrifying gaze
reference: MythosAI project notes, summarized from scripts/populate_data.py: Medusa monster record
text: Medusa is a Gorgon with snake hair and a petrifying gaze. She turns people to stone. The project's monster record lists reflective surfaces among her weaknesses and classifies her threat level as extreme.

title: Percy Jackson's parentage and water powers
reference: MythosAI project notes, summarized from scripts/populate_data.py: Percy Jackson, powers, and character-power assignments
text: In the project's Percy Jackson setting, Percy is a son of Poseidon. His assigned powers include hydrokinesis, swordsmanship, and communication with horses. Hydrokinesis means control over water and related phenomena. Percy first appears in The Lightning Thief.

title: Annabeth Chase and strategic thinking
reference: MythosAI project notes, summarized from scripts/populate_data.py: Annabeth Chase and Strategic Mind power assignment
text: In the project's Percy Jackson setting, Annabeth Chase is a daughter of Athena and an architect and strategist. Her assigned Strategic Mind power describes enhanced tactical and strategic thinking. Annabeth first appears in The Lightning Thief.
